[NEW] Website that lists dozens of awesome .io games like agar and slither... You think these can grow to slither status?

main things that IO games need: optimization

frustrum/occlusion culling/hidden surface culling (not rendering stuff off screen)

draw call optimization (grouping stuff up so it doesn't have to do a look up on 100000 identical objects)

level streaming (unloading the level when it's too far away)

level of detail/rasterization (not having it be vectorized, but have a set object quality on a set distance, that swaps in when zooming)

graphics resolution options (if you want performance over smooth edges or fancy glows)

proper memory management (garbage collection, multi threading, well done raster interrupts, etcetera)
